_comment: UI-feel ratchet baseline — per-check counts of @jovie/ui-feel violations (JOV-8197). To change: fix violations then run `pnpm --filter web lint:ui-feel -- --update` (or `node scripts/lint-ui-feel.mjs --update`) and commit this file. CI fails if any count drifts from its baseline in either direction — growth is a regression, and shrink without this update is stale headroom.
